Name: Ox Drawn Plough - Medieval Tractor Retexture
Author: SharkTeethy
Description:
For those who play with mods like [i]Medieval Buildings [/i]and [i]Way Back Pelican Town [/i]and want to play with the tractor mod while keeping the vibes. Also for those who just really like draft animals! 😁 I tried to make the harness and plow as accurate as possible within my constraints, but I'm no expert. I made this mod about a year ago and only just got around to publishing it, but the mod still works. Happy to finally have it out there!

There are now two animal options, a brown ox and a black horse, and the tractor power buff icon is an ox! I tried to make it so you could choose in config for it to be a horse as well, but it didn't work. I kept the code and asset in the files though, so you can manually change it to a horse if you want by changing the name of the buffhorse icon to buffox. 

I'm still working on a zebu option, as well as more color variants for all the animals. I'm also thinking of changing the sound the tractor makes into horse/cow noises, but I don't know much about how the audio files work in this game so it will likely be a while. 😓

Downloads.Description: A brown ox, A black horse, and a unique buff icon!
